> Professional Wedding Pet Attendant & Day-Of Care Services serving Central Ohio (Columbus, Dublin, Powell, New Albany, Westerville, Delaware, and surrounding areas. Statewide Ohio travel available). Owned and operated by Lacie Kern with 14+ years of dedicated pet care experience.

- Geographic Coverage: Central Ohio (Columbus Metro, Dublin, Powell, New Albany, Westerville, Upper Arlington, Worthington, Delaware, Grove City, Gahanna, Pickerington). Travel across Ohio for wedding venues with arrangement.

## Wedding Attendant Packages
1. The Ceremony & Portraits Package (2.5 – 3 Hours): Pre-ceremony dressing, aisle escort, ring handling, photo assistant with squeakers/treats, and chauffeured ride home.
2. The Full Wedding Day VIP Experience (5 – 6 Hours): Getting-ready photos at bridal suite, aisle escort, cocktail hour greeting, extended photo support, dinner service, and bedtime tuck-in.
3. The Rehearsal & Wedding Weekend Experience: Venue rehearsal run-through with pup, full wedding day care, and next-morning departure breakfast/walk.
4. Daily In-Home Pet Sitting & Routine Visits: Drop-in care, dog walking, and medication administration across Central Ohio.
